xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4932: Agent MCP and bots (W-INJ1): Claude Code: inject the server into agents, role runs and conversations

plan.title: Agent MCP and bots (W-INJ1): Claude Code: inject the server into agents, role runs and conversations
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: W-INJ1 is already one child of the PAN-4927 epic. Its surface is one helper (agent-injection.ts) spread with one line into each of the seven Claude Code launch sites (buildAgentLaunchConfig, spawnRun, recoverAgent, messageAgent fallback, fresh planning, planning continuation, conversations), each with its own test file, plus the config switch, the harness capability and two doc pages. Splitting the sites into sibling issues would leave some agent kinds without the tools between merges and would not shrink any single diff: every site item is 1-4 lines. Each two-segment doc path (configuration/mcp.mdx, configuration/harnesses.mdx, .pan/drafts) counts as its own subsystem in the lint; the code spans src/lib, src/dashboard, packages/contracts and tests/unit. 34 files in total: 14 test files, 3 doc files and 17 production files; no existing production file grows by more than 8 lines, and the new code lives in three new modules (agent-injection.ts, overdeck-mcp-args.ts, mcp-config.ts).

narratives.Problem: Overdeck's managed Claude Code agents never get the Overdeck MCP server; they reach Overdeck through pan with the machine's admin token. W-TOK1 (PAN-4930) built per-agent tokens and W-MCP1 (PAN-4931) made pan mcp serve read a 0600 token file, but no launch site mints a token or passes the server to Claude Code.
narratives.Proposal: Add a config switch (mcp.agents, default true), a harness capability overdeckMcp (Claude Code only for now), a leaf module with the equals-form launch flags (--mcp-config=<file> and, when no allow-list exists, --allowedTools=mcp__overdeck), and src/lib/mcp/agent-injection.ts whose prepareClaudeOverdeckMcp mints the owner's token, writes <dir>/overdeck-mcp.json (0600, path only) and returns { overdeckMcpConfig } or {} when disabled or on failure. Spread it with one line into every Claude Code launch site on this host: inside buildAgentLaunchConfig (covers work agents, resume and recovery callers), spawnRun, recoverAgent, the messageAgent fallback, fresh planning, the planning continuation route, and spawnConversationSession (conversation token role by lane, flywheel and pane role; bare conversations skipped). Role allow-lists always name mcp__overdeck. The sweep keeps a token younger than its grace when the agent state is not saved yet, which planning launches need. Document the injection in configuration/mcp.mdx and the capability and CP-1 result in configuration/harnesses.mdx.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No injection for codex, acp, opencode, kimi-code, ohmypi, muse or prime-agent (W-INJ2, W-INJ3, W-INJ4)
- No MCP or CLI instructions block in the launch context (W-INJ4)
- No injection for Fly or other remote launches (remote/remote-agents.ts)
- No injection in Docker workspaces or bare conversations
- No new MCP tool, HTTP route or scope, and no change to pan mcp serve
- No change to token minting, revocation or stop paths except the sweep's missing-state grace
- No placeholder agent-state row before a planning launch
- No docs/ROLES.md, CLAUDE.md or cli/mcp.mdx edits (W-DOC)
- Never put a token in a launcher script, an MCP config file, argv, an env export or a log line
- Never compare a harness name; never raise a file-size allowlist row or a ratchet baseline

autoDecisions.summary: harnessGetsOverdeckMcp reads a new HarnessCapabilities field overdeckMcp instead of a list of harness names.
autoDecisions.rationale: configuration/harnesses.mdx says behavior decisions read a capability field and never compare a harness name, and scripts/lint-harness-branches.sh fails new name comparisons.

autoDecisions.summary: Only Claude Code declares overdeckMcp: true in this item; W-INJ2 and W-INJ3 flip Codex, ACP and opencode when they wire them.
autoDecisions.rationale: A capability states what the harness does now; declaring it early would let W-INJ4's instructions block promise tools those agents do not have.

autoDecisions.summary: The work-agent mint lives inside buildAgentLaunchConfig, spread into both its resume and fresh generateLauncherScript calls.
autoDecisions.rationale: Its six callers (spawn.ts, resume.ts, recovery.ts x4) then get the server with no site code; the epic's spawn.ts-only call would miss resumes and recoveries.

autoDecisions.summary: Launch flags use the equals form: --mcp-config=<path> and --allowedTools=mcp__overdeck.
autoDecisions.rationale: A probe on Claude Code 2.1.293 showed the space form of --allowedTools swallows a following positional prompt, and buildNonConversationCommand can end with "$prompt" right after the injected flags.

autoDecisions.summary: Planning sessions are covered by a sweep grace for missing agent state instead of an early state save.
autoDecisions.rationale: CLAUDE.md forbids placeholder agent-state rows before the terminal session exists; a mint after launch would race the MCP server start.

autoDecisions.summary: A failed mint or config write launches the agent without the overdeck server and logs one warning.
autoDecisions.rationale: Agent tokens give identity, not a sandbox (epic H-1); a corrupt token registry must not stop every agent launch, and the agent still has pan.

autoDecisions.summary: Conversation token role: lane row -> worker, conv-flywheel -> flywheel, pane role uat -> test, conversation -> conversation, other pane roles by name.
autoDecisions.rationale: Epic D-8 gives approve only to the operator's chat; PAN-4930 H-8 asks lanes to use worker; uat is not a Role key in AGENT_TOKEN_SCOPES.

autoDecisions.summary: bareContext conversations get no overdeck server; plainFork conversations do.
autoDecisions.rationale: bareContext means skip every Overdeck-injected layer, which play lanes rely on to see the product as a new user.

autoDecisions.summary: The stdio server env carries OVERDECK_DASHBOARD_URL from getDashboardLoopbackApiUrl().
autoDecisions.rationale: Inside the dashboard DASHBOARD_URL can be the public TLS URL (PAN-3331); a child that inherits it fails every call.

autoDecisions.summary: overdeckMcpEnabledFor is async and reads loadConfigNoMigration().
autoDecisions.rationale: spawnRun and spawnConversationSession run on the dashboard hot path; the repo bans new blocking reads there.

autoDecisions.summary: The planning continuation route (routes/misc/planning.ts) is in scope.
autoDecisions.rationale: FR-1 covers every role run; one spread line keeps a continued planner's tools.

autoDecisions.summary: mcp.public.enabled is added to the config module now and read by nothing in this item.
autoDecisions.rationale: The epic assigns the mcp config module to W-INJ1 and W-FUN1 builds on it.
